newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH CAR DEALERS CUT '97 SALES FORECAST 3.6 PCT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH CAR DEALERS CUT '97 SALES FORECAST 3.6 PCT.

text.p: Finnish car dealers have cut their forecast for 1997 new private car sales to 106,000 from 110,000, the Information Centre of the Automobile Branch said in a statement on Friday.
"The brand new cyclical barometer of the Autombobile Branch forecasts sales of 106,000 new private cars this year and 114,000 next year," the centre said.
"The car dealers ... are realistic and see a moderate development for the branch," it said.
In 1996, registrations of new private cars increased 20 percent to 95,830 units, the automobile branch said. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
